name: Oakland LGBTQ Community Center
description: Free support groups, community events, wellness services, and senior/youth programming
fullDescription: The Oakland LGBTQ Community Center provides a safe and affirming space with support groups, the Glenn Burke Wellness Clinic, senior and youth programs, and community events at sites across Oakland.
whatTheyOffer:
- Support groups, including trans and nonbinary circles
- Aging With Pride senior services
- Youth services and the Town Youth Club
- Glenn Burke Wellness Clinic (sexual health testing and wellness care)
- Trans Wellness Center in East Oakland
- Rental and housing assistance resources and food pantry
- Rainbow Recovery Program and 12-step meetings
- Community events and celebrations
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the main campus (entrance on Rand Ave) Monday-Friday, 12-6 PM
2. Check the website calendar for groups and events
3. Call 510-882-2286 for general questions
4. Call the Glenn Burke Wellness Clinic at 510-781-2639 for medical services
5. East Oakland clinic and Trans Wellness Center are at 8400 Enterprise Way
keywords: Oakland LGBTQ, LGBTQ community center, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, support groups, Glenn Burke Wellness Clinic, sexual health testing, seniors, youth, housing assistance, food pantry, recovery support
